news.title: Vance faces tough questions on Iran war, immigration and more in CBS town hall
news.summary: The string of sharp queries, some from voters who said they had supported him and President Donald Trump, previewed the rocky path Vance may face trying to answer for the administration's record if he runs for president himself in 2028.
